title: The MembershipWorks plugin for WordPress before 6.17 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows…
description: The MembershipWorks WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.17 have an information disclosure vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access member-only content via the WordPress REST API. The vulnerability exists because the content protection filter is applied only during normal front-end requests and not during REST API requests, enabling bypass of content restrictions.
